posts.text:
Mint day on Tuesday having a blast back round Cadwell. -
Funny coming back here after some time on much wider and open tracks, definitely a surprise not having the run off I’ve taking for granted whilst being away 😂. 
-
Always such good fun riding my Triumph, brilliant day enjoying the sunshine and being on 2 wheels 😎. 
-
Thank you to Brad and Leon for working on the bike for the day!

It’s been a long way since my injury in September 2025. After 2 surgeries, 1 plate & 7 screws later, I’m very pleased to say I’ve smashed 2 of my running PB’s last weekend! Saturday’s 5k Park run with a mega time of 18:08, and Sundays 10k race pipping just under the 40 minute mark of a 39:55 😋. 
-
So, for this I’d like to say a huge thank you to my personal trainer Mark Walker cycling coach for setting out the correct training and rehab programs to ensure I have returned back to full fitness without any strange aches or pains along the way. I trust Mark all the way and very thankful to have him in my corner for the advice on training, diet, recovery & mindset. 
-
On top of this, I’d like to give a massive shoutout to CH2RGE for the product sponsorship of their Hydrogen water cans, providing recovery drinks helping me after a hard weekend 🥵. 
-
Also Bona Botanica for the Mangosteen Puree gels for quick and easily digestible nutrition for everyday use, before and after training sessions to help with my energy levels and diet. 
-
Making good use during the summer break! Very looking forward to building on these results I achieved today 😎.
Great job Jake, smashing your swim time 👏👏
